facts.why: Tina is Mookie's girlfriend in Bed-Stuy. No delivery to her, and nothing about her living upstairs.

facts.text: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.
facts.why: Mookie works as a delivery man at Sal's, but no first delivery is described.
facts.fix: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie heads in to work at Sal's.

facts.why: Sal tells both Pino and Vito to get a broom and sweep out front, so Vito is not alone on it.
facts.fix: Sidewalk swept daily by Pino and Vito.

vibe.verdict: A warm Bed-Stuy pizzeria with a good Wall of Fame, Love and Hate rings and the cherry ice. It stays on the surface of the film.
